label_policy: Frozen before M2.4 live queries. A supported answer requires every expected fact with semantic source support; exact gold citations are diagnostic. Each fact_evidence quote is verbatim from the pinned nodes.json. Refusals have no gold facts or citations.

cases.question: 球员因违反体育道德行为收到一次或两次技术犯规时，驱逐规则是什么？
expected_facts: A player, coach, trainer, or bench person may be ejected for one unsportsmanlike act and must be ejected for two.

fact_evidence.fact: A player, coach, trainer, or bench person may be ejected for one unsportsmanlike act and must be ejected for two.
fact_evidence.quote:
Any of these offenders may be ejected 
for committing only one unsportsmanlike act, and they must be ejected for committing two 
unsportsmanlike acts.

cases.question: When officials are unsure whether a called personal foul was a clear-path-to-the-basket foul, is that listed as an instant replay trigger?
expected_facts: Yes. Uncertainty about whether a called personal foul meets clear-path criteria is listed as an instant replay trigger.

fact_evidence.fact: Yes. Uncertainty about whether a called personal foul meets clear-path criteria is listed as an instant replay trigger.
fact_evidence.quote:
Officials are not reasonably certain whether a personal foul called at any time  
during a game met the criteria for a clear-path-to-the-basket foul.

cases.question: What is the minimum number of dressed, eligible players for a regular-season game versus a playoff game?
expected_facts: A team needs at least eight dressed, eligible and able players in a regular-season game and nine in a playoff game.

fact_evidence.fact: A team needs at least eight dressed, eligible and able players in a regular-season game and nine in a playoff game.
fact_evidence.quote:
A team must have a minimum of eight players dressed and eligible and able to play in each 
preseason and regular season game and nine in each Play-In and playoff game.

cases.question: 挥拳没有击中对手，经即时回放确认后，球员面临什么驱逐和停赛处罚？
expected_facts: A punch is unsportsmanlike whether it connects or not; after replay confirmation, the player is ejected and suspended at least one game.

fact_evidence.fact: A punch is unsportsmanlike whether it connects or not; after replay confirmation, the player is ejected and suspended at least one game.
fact_evidence.quote:

unsportsmanlike act. He will be ejected following confirmation during review by instant  
replay and suspended for a minimum of one game.

cases.question: 调整后的防守篮板机会率衡量什么？其公式为何要减去延让的防守篮板机会？
expected_facts: Adjusted defensive rebound chance percentage is the percentage of defensive rebound chances converted into rebounds, excluding deferred rebounds.
Its formula is DREB divided by DREB chances minus deferred DREB chances.

fact_evidence.fact: Adjusted defensive rebound chance percentage is the percentage of defensive rebound chances converted into rebounds, excluding deferred rebounds.
fact_evidence.quote: Percentage of rebounds gathered when given a rebound chance on defense; excludes all deferred rebounds

fact_evidence.fact: Its formula is DREB divided by DREB chances minus deferred DREB chances.
fact_evidence.quote: (DREB)/(DREB Chances - Deferred DREB Chances)

cases.question: In the NBA glossary, what event contributes to And One Frequency?
expected_facts: An and-one play is a made field goal with an awarded free throw because of a shooting foul; the metric is the percentage of plays with that result.

fact_evidence.fact: An and-one play is a made field goal with an awarded free throw because of a shooting foul; the metric is the percentage of plays with that result.
fact_evidence.quote: The percentage of plays where a player or team makes a field goal while also being awarded a free throw attempt due to a shooting foul

cases.question: 统计中的 Boxouts 要满足怎样的身体接触和篮板结果条件？
expected_facts: A boxout involves physical contact with an opponent pursuing a rebound, a visible effort to disadvantage them, and successfully preventing them from securing it.

fact_evidence.fact: A boxout involves physical contact with an opponent pursuing a rebound, a visible effort to disadvantage them, and successfully preventing them from securing it.
fact_evidence.quote: The number of times a player made physical contact with an opponent who was actively pursuing a rebound, showed visible progress or strong effort in disadvantaging the opponent, and successfully prevented that opponent from securing the rebound

cases.question: For adjusted assist-to-pass percentage, which three kinds of assists count, and what is the denominator?
expected_facts: The numerator includes assists, free-throw assists, and secondary assists.
The denominator is passes made by the player or team.

fact_evidence.fact: The numerator includes assists, free-throw assists, and secondary assists.
fact_evidence.quote: assists, free throw assists, or secondary assists

fact_evidence.fact: The denominator is passes made by the player or team.
fact_evidence.quote: (Adjusted Assists)/(Passes Made)

cases.question: Contested DREB% 是如何计算的？
expected_facts: Contested DREB% is the share of a player's defensive rebounds collected with an opponent within 3.5 feet, divided by all defensive rebounds.

fact_evidence.fact: Contested DREB% is the share of a player's defensive rebounds collected with an opponent within 3.5 feet, divided by all defensive rebounds.
fact_evidence.quote:
The percentage of defensive rebounds the player collects while an opponent is within 3.5 feet of the rebounder
Formula
(Contested DREB)/(DREB)
